boundsExplanation.cadReportedBoundsMethod: Local prototype bounding boxes transformed by each occurrence matrix and merged; rotated boxes are conservative. Prototype boxes used for visualization also depend on geometry/mesh bounding implementation.
boundsExplanation.brepComparisonMethod: Independent XCAF import, BRepBndLib.AddOptimal(useTriangulation=False,useShapeTolerance=False) for every exported world shape vs the independently imported source/candidate moved once by the project pose.
boundsExplanation.conclusion: All 194 poses and world BRep bounds match expected geometry; there is no evidence of double-applied Location or assembly displacement. The CAD viewer box extrema are not a tight world-geometry measurement.

limitations: STEP is readable and all expected leaves/placements exist; both source and exported topology are invalid, requiring review/repair.
